clue.text: Coming before the bar opens is optimistic

definitions.meaning: in music the unaccented beat that leads into the first full bar
cheerful and hopeful about the future

explanation.surface: Someone eagerly anticipating opening time at the pub is in a cheerful mood.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'bar' looks like a pub, but it is a musical bar: the upbeat is the note played before the first bar begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a musical anacrusis, and a cheerful, positive outlook.

clue.text: Left the blaze spreading around one in the country

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are placed around the letter standing for one
the words of the blaze spread out and scatter into a new order

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Fire spreads across the left-hand side of some nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spreading' rearranges THE BLAZE to ELZABETH, and 'around' puts I inside it after EL. The puzzle's unstated theme is South Africa, so 'in the country' means a place there.
explanation.definitionFit: Port Elizabeth is a coastal city in South Africa, the country running through this whole puzzle.

clue.text: See 2
Tease companion for involuntary movement

parts.note: to twit is to tease or taunt someone
CH is the abbreviation for Companion of Honour

explanation.surface: Teasing a friend provokes an involuntary jerk.
explanation.definitionFit: A twitch is a sudden small jerk of a muscle that happens without intent.

clue.text: Parrot that is settled in the country

indicators.note: settled suggests the letters coming to rest in a new arrangement

parts.note: i.e. is the Latin abbreviation for that is

explanation.surface: A parrot has made its home somewhere in a nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'settled' rearranges PARROT plus IE. The country is South Africa, the puzzle's theme.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretoria is South Africa's administrative capital, so it is a place within that country.

clue.text: Favourable to papers' turnabout which is exerted by one gas

definitions.text: which is exerted by one gas

parts.note: partial to something means fond of it
the press is the newspapers collectively
a U-turn, so U stands for a turn
re is Latin for about, concerning

explanation.surface: A newspaper's change of heart suits its owners, though in chemistry that is not what this means.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turnabout' splits into 'turn' (U, as in U-turn) and 'about' (RE).
explanation.definitionFit: In a mixture of gases, each component contributes its own share of the total pressure, called its partial pressure.

clue.text: Good man interrupting oaths from the 9?

indicators.note: the good man breaks into the middle of the oaths

parts.note: egads is a mild old oath
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A virtuous man breaks off people swearing, among the clever ones.
explanation.walkthrough: The 9 refers to 9 across, so the definition means the cleverer people; 'interrupting' places the good man in the middle of the oaths.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggheads are intellectuals, people thought cleverer than most, so they are the brainier ones.

clue.text: Showing? About time!

parts.note: over can mean about, as in fussing over something

explanation.surface: Is it on yet? And not before time!
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means open and plainly visible, the way something showing is.

clue.text: Main lines are showing Queen 3 as Sikh

indicators.note: showing the queen dressed as a Sikh means presenting her wearing the turban, so her letters sit within

parts.note: a Sikh man wears a turban, so dressed as one is in turban
the queen of 3 down, Elizabeth, abbreviated ER

explanation.surface: Main lines picture Queen Elizabeth dressed as a Sikh.
explanation.walkthrough: 3 is 3 down, ELIZABETH, whose royal cipher is ER. ER placed into IN TURBAN, after the T, gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Interurban railways are the main lines running between cities.

clue.text: The Black Prince having more intelligence

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
Prince Rainier ruled Monaco

explanation.surface: Edward the Black Prince was the cleverer one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Black Prince' reads as Edward III's son, but splits into B and Prince Rainier of Monaco.
explanation.definitionFit: Brainier is the comparative of brainy, so it means cleverer.

clue.text: Energy keeps male abstainer from segregated area

indicators.note: the energy word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: go means energy or vigour
he is the male pronoun
TT is teetotal, a person who abstains from alcohol

explanation.surface: Vigour keeps a sober man away from the segregated district.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghetto is a part of a city where a minority group is confined or lives apart.

clue.text: Art like rocket science in bright star (not American, English)

indicators.note: the hi-tech phrase sits inside the altered star name
the letters for American are dropped and the letter for English put in their place

parts.note: Arcturus is one of the brightest stars in the sky
hi-tec, an informal spelling of high-tech, describes rocket science

explanation.surface: Is the art like rocket science, studied by an English star-gazer?
explanation.walkthrough: 'not American, English' swaps the US ending of the star's name for E; 'in' places the hi-tech word inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Architecture is the art of designing buildings.

clue.text: Cockney scene in the country

definitions.meaning: the East End of London is where Cockneys traditionally live
a port city in the Eastern Cape of South Africa, the puzzle's country

explanation.surface: A Cockney setting found within some nation.
explanation.definitionFit: The name fits both London's East End, home of Cockneys, and a South African city.

clue.text: French king to have a place in the country

parts.note: Hugh Capet was a medieval king of France
to own is to have

explanation.surface: A French monarch acquires a home somewhere in a nation.
explanation.walkthrough: The country is South Africa, the puzzle's theme.
explanation.definitionFit: Cape Town is one of South Africa's capital cities.

clue.text: Egg-laying beetle?

parts.note: read as a female bird that lays eggs, it also names a small spotted beetle

explanation.definitionFit: The insect is a small red beetle with black spots, and a lady bird would also lay eggs.

clue.text: Get struck on the shoulder, heard not seen?

indicators.note: heard tells us the phrase is spoken aloud, giving the sound of another word

parts.note: to be knighted, touched on the shoulder with a sword

explanation.surface: To receive a knighthood is to be noticed but not seen.
explanation.walkthrough: The silent K means 'be knighted' sounds the same as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Benighted means overtaken by darkness, so a benighted traveller cannot be seen.

clue.text: A singer fellow near Oxford

parts.note: Bing Crosby, the American crooner
a don is a fellow of a university college

explanation.surface: A crooner and a college fellow live close to Oxford.
explanation.definitionFit: Abingdon is a market town a few miles south of Oxford.

clue.text: Where the defendant is after a drink …

definitions.meaning: a prisoner stands in the dock before the court
someone getting a drink is at the pub counter

explanation.surface: Where the accused goes after having a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase covers both the courtroom bar and the counter at a pub.

clue.text: … which is simple for an ox

definitions.meaning: an old word for cattle or an ox

explanation.surface: Something plain enough for an ox to manage.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links back to the drink: a drink taken without mixers is simple. Neat is an archaic word for bovine animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat means plain or undiluted, and also, in old usage, an ox or cow.

clue.text: Cross out half of 8 in the country

annotationWithheld.why: Clue 'Cross out half of 8 in the country' (6): half of 8 (INTERURBAN) gives URBAN, but no clue word accounts for the leading D with a sound parse
annotationWithheld.clue: Cross out half of 8 in the country

clue.text: Runabout hard on queen's sticky plant in the country

indicators.note: the run goes about, around the other pieces

parts.note: to jog is to run at a gentle pace
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
Queen Anne, the British monarch
a bur is a seed head that clings to clothing

explanation.surface: A runner passes a sticky plant belonging to the queen somewhere in a nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runabout' looks like a small car, but splits into 'Run' and 'about', the second wrapping the run around the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Johannesburg is South Africa's largest city.

clue.text: Complete set of books, a sign to the audience

parts.note: all is the whole lot
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: A full collection of books is shown to the audience.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition works by sound: 'a sign', spoken to an audience, is 'assign'.
explanation.definitionFit: To allot is to assign or allocate, and 'a sign' heard aloud is assign.

clue.text: See 13
How duck went west, taken off

indicators.note: taken here means removed, the letter for west is taken away

parts.note: a duck waddled along

explanation.surface: A duck waddled away westward and then flew off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'went west' suggests dying, but 'west' is W, removed from WADDLED.
explanation.definitionFit: An addled egg has gone bad, so it is off.

clue.text: Move through holes and tell

definitions.meaning: to pass buttons back through their buttonholes to open a garment
to open up and speak freely

explanation.surface: Push something through openings and tell all.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to undo buttons and, figuratively, to relax and open up.

clue.text: Example of fashionable attitude

parts.note: in means in fashion
a stance is an attitude or position

explanation.surface: An example of a trendy pose.
explanation.definitionFit: An instance is a single example or case of something.

clue.text: A row in direction giving name to writer of the country

definitions.text: name to writer of the country

indicators.note: the row sits inside the compass direction

parts.note: NE is northeast, a compass direction
a din is a noisy row

explanation.surface: A quarrel somewhere gives its name to a national author.
explanation.walkthrough: The writer is Nadine Gordimer, South Africa's Nobel-winning novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Nadine is the first name of Gordimer, the South African novelist.
